outboxPolicy.name: owner_export_outbox_worker_insert
outboxPolicy.withCheck:
((event_type = 'portability.export_produced.v1'::text) AND (schema_version = 1) AND ((aggregate_id)::text ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text) AND ( SELECT ((count(*))::integer = 2)
   FROM jsonb_object_keys(outbox_events.payload) jsonb_object_keys(jsonb_object_keys)) AND (payload ?& ARRAY['exportId'::text, 'manifest'::text]) AND ((payload ->> 'exportId'::text) = (aggregate_id)::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((payload -> 'manifest'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND ((payload -> 'manifest'::text) ?& ARRAY['schemaVersion'::text, 'exportId'::text, 'checksumSha256'::text, 'recordCounts'::text]) AND (((payload -> 'manifest'::text) ->> 'exportId'::text) = (aggregate_id)::text))
